fields.title: Index Budget
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The orders table has six indexes, the budget is four. What do you remove?
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: `(store)` 2. `(store, date)` 3. `(user, date)` 4. `(status)` 5. `(phone)` — for support, 20 requests per day 6. `(amount)` — for admin screen, 8 views per month
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: remove 1 (fully covered by the second one, working left to right), 4 (low selectivity — three values do not narrow down the dataset), 6 (10 thousand updates per single view). 2, 3, 5 remain. Protect the fifth: 20 requests a day is an active operational scenario, and without an index, searching by phone means a full scan of eight million rows.
